name: claude-context-sidebar
description: A list of every Claude Code chat's context window, right inside the Claude Code sidebar. Switch between all chats and just the one you are in, with real chat names and a compaction count.

contextMeter.assumedWindow.markdownDescription: Your Claude Code context window in tokens, for example `200000` or `1000000`. `0` means not set: the sidebar then shows tokens used without a percentage and asks you once. Run **Context Meter: Set my window size** to set it. The optional companion mod reports the exact window and makes this setting unnecessary. Chats that already hold more tokens than this are treated as 1M automatically.

contextMeter.amberAt.description: Percent at which a chat turns amber.

contextMeter.redAt.description: Percent at which a chat turns red and shows the warning.

contextMeter.maxAgeHours.description: Chats not touched for this many hours are left out of the list.

contextMeter.hideTitlesMatching.markdownDescription: Hide chats whose title matches this regular expression (case-insensitive), for example `\(old\)` to hide chats you renamed with "(old)".

contextMeter.showOwnIcon.description: Show a Context Sidebar icon of its own in the activity bar. Only needed if the list does not appear inside the Claude Code sidebar (for example after a Claude Code update changes it).

commands.title: Claude Context Sidebar: Set my window size
